messages:
emily: Quick sync on StratusLink co-marketing. Scope: joint benchmark post, marketplace listing copy, and a tech webinar. Target week: webinar 6/14, post 6/16, marketplace promo 6/17-6/23.
raj: Goals: attribution from marketplace -> trials, highlight 95th %ile latency, and show per-token cost improvements for realistic RLHF-ish workloads.
vince: I'll gather bench numbers. Eng will provide `stratuslink_bench_summary.csv` + short methodology blurb. ETA Tue.
olga: I'll draft the landing page and the marketplace short description. Need headline variants—2 technical, 2 product. Can we land numbers by Wed so I can finalize?
emily: Use guarded language: "observed up to 32% lower token cost in our test harness" and link to methodology. No promises.
sasha: Ops routing: marketplace leads -> SFDC Campaign = "StratusLink-Synd-2026"; set origin=stratus_mp, and create a webhook to #sdr-oncall. Also ensure form has hidden partner_id=STR-0626.
raj: Tracking plan: UTM utm_source=stratuslink, utm_campaign=stratus-synd-0626, utm_medium=referral. Vince, can you paste the GTM snippet into the LP when ready?
vince: Yes. Also packaging demo: I'll containerize demo runner: `docker run redwood/stratus-demo:bench-2026 -p 8080:8080`. Will attach run instructions.
olga: Webinar format idea: 20m partner talk, 20m benchmark deep-dive, 15m live demo, 15m Q&A. Need rehearsal slot week of 6/8.
emily: Legal dependency: Stratus legal signoff on co-marketing brief + logo use by 5/30. If delayed, we'll still run webinar but delay public benchmark post.
sasha: Lead handling: If lead.company_size > 200 & intent=POC -> escalate to enterprise SDRs within 8 hours. Else route to integrations pool. Create queue `sdr-integrations-stratus`.
raj: Also add retention trigger: if marketplace signup consumes >12k tokens in first 10 days, create growth@redwood alert for Dedicated upsell.
olvince: minor ask: please include a reproducibility section in the blog with exact model, batch, seq lengths. We will not release raw logs.
olga: I'll draft social copy: short X thread + LinkedIn long form. Will A/B headlines on LP for first 48 hours.
emily: Action recap: Olga (LP + social + headlines), Vince (bench CSV + demo container + GTM), Raj (tracking + measurement), Sasha (SFDC rules + Zap), Emily (partner comms + webinar host).
marketing-bot: Rehearsal event created -> 1775600000.
emily: Final: no public posts until legal signoff AND live tracking verified. We'll reconvene Fri 5/24 9am PT for greenlight. :rocket:
